_comment: Extends base.json, NOT node.json, and deliberately narrows types:
types: []   — no @types/node. An accidental `node:fs` import fails to
compile here, which is what keeps this package usable
from the browser bundle and the VS Code extension host.
lib: +DOM   — for the web-standard types only (fetch, Headers,
RequestInit). These exist in every target runtime;
including them is not a licence to touch `document`.
Both lines are load-bearing. Dropping types: [] removes the guardrail;
